tweetHighlights.whyItMatters: 这条文字动态直接覆盖你的关注主题：Coding Agents。
tweetHighlights.originalTitle: Founders must stop trying to building 2010-era businesses with 2026-era technology.
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Founders must stop trying to building 2010-era businesses with 2026-era technology. 

Don't try to rebuild Foursquare or Yelp. 

Don't try to recreate Basecamp by 37 Signals with $10/mo SaaS pricing. 

Don't underprice! If it works it's worth a lot more.

Don't be tempted to become "Tech enabled PE" with revenue tricks. 

The rules of tech changed with AI. Play the new game.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 创始人必须停止试图用 2026 年的技术来打造 2010 年时代的企业。
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
创始人必须停止试图用2026年的技术打造2010年的商业模式。

不要试图重建Foursquare或Yelp。

不要试图以每月10美元的SaaS价格复制37 Signals的Basecamp。

不要定价过低！如果产品成功，它的价值远不止于此。

不要被“技术赋能型私募股权”的诱惑所迷惑，用各种盈利技巧来牟利。

人工智能改变了科技行业的规则。适应新的游戏规则吧。

tweetHighlights.originalBody:
- image or video editing? write scripts
- finances, tax work, etc? put in PDFs, write scripts, output HTML
- medical advice? put in PDFs + data, output HTML 
- filling out paperwork? write scripts
- creating a report? write HTML
- making plans? write HTML
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: - 图片编辑还是视频编辑？
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
- 图片或视频编辑？编写脚本

- 财务、税务等工作？导入 PDF 文件，编写脚本，输出 HTML

- 医疗咨询？导入 PDF 文件和数据，输出 HTML

- 填写表格？编写脚本

- 创建报告？编写 HTML

- 制定计划？编写 HTML
